panels.resize: Drag to change the width · double-click: default width

connector.tooTall: A lift reaches up to 48 m: in the game you need to chain two or use floor holes.
connector.ports: The bottom port is shown on floor {{bottom}} and the top one on floor {{top}}.

power.title: Plan power
power.infiniteOn: Assumes there is a grid able to power the whole plan: no need to run power lines. Any lines you draw count as connected to that grid.
power.infiniteOff: Every machine must be wired to a grid with generators, or to a pole hooked up to your world grid.
power.worldHint: You can read them in game on any power pole or in the power panel. Do not include this plan.
power.enough: Enough: with the plan built you have {{mw}} MW left.
power.notEnough: Not enough: {{mw}} MW short. You need more generators before building this.
power.fillWorld: Enter your world production and consumption to see whether it is enough.

palette.pathHint: Click a port or the ground to start and click again to finish the segment.

community.title: Community
community.guestHint: You can view plans without an account. Sign in to share your own.
community.empty: No shared plans yet. Share one from My plans.
community.emptyQuery: No shared plans with that name yet. Share one from My plans.

production.bottleneck: Producing at {{pct}} of ideal: each cycle takes {{actual}} s instead of {{ideal}} s waiting for {{item}}.
production.outputLimited: The output cannot take everything it could produce: the belt is at capacity or what follows consumes less. The rest builds up in the machine.
production.adviceUnder: Downstream needs less: with the clock at {{pct}} it makes exactly what is needed and uses less power.
production.adviceOver: Not enough for what downstream needs: set the clock to {{pct}}.
production.adviceOverClock: Not enough for what downstream needs: set the clock to {{pct}} (overclock: {{shards}} power shard(s)) or add one more machine.
production.adviceImpossible: Not even 250 % is enough: downstream needs the equivalent of {{pct}}. You need {{machines}} machines at 100 % (or {{max}} at 250 %).

splitter.help: Each output lets through what its filter says. Any Undefined takes the items no other output names and Overflow gets what does not fit in the others.

merger.help: What the output needs is taken first from the inputs with the highest priority (1).

storage.capacityFluid: Capacity: {{n}} m³. Works as a buffer: it absorbs differences in rate between what goes in and what comes out.
storage.capacitySlots: Capacity: {{n}} slots. Works as a buffer: it absorbs differences in rate between what goes in and what comes out.
storage.connect: Connect belts or pipes to see how long it takes to fill.
storage.fills: Fills up in {{time}}; then it backs up the input.
storage.empties: Empties in {{time}} if it starts full.
storage.steady: As much goes in as comes out: the level holds.

route.distanceHint: Empty: the drawn path or, with no waypoints, the straight line + 20 % (drones fly straight). Type a value to use the real distance you measured in the game.
route.roundTrip: Round trip: {{t}} s ({{dist}} m of travel + {{dock}} s loading and unloading).
route.genericCapacity: {{n}}/min for items that stack to 100. Connect belts to the origin station to see the real item.

source.drawn_one: Distance of the drawn path (1 waypoint).
source.drawn_other: Distance of the drawn path ({{count}} waypoints).
source.droneStraight: Drones fly in a straight line.

route.drawHelp: With the route selected: drag a point to move it, double-click the path to add one and double-click a point to remove it.
route.fuelTrip: {{n}} per round trip · {{m}}/min for the whole route
route.fuelElectric: Trains are electric: the locomotive draws 25 to 110 MW from the grid.
route.fuelDrone: Per trip: 24,000 MJ plus 6 MJ per meter. Speed depends on the fuel.

side.buildingHelp: Rotation {{rot}}° · <kbd>R</kbd> rotate · right-click or <kbd>Esc</kbd> to exit
side.drawingHelpBelt: Capacity {{cap}}. Click a port (or the ground, which places a pole) to start and click again to finish. If you finish on the ground, drawing continues from there. Up to 56 m per segment.
side.drawingHelpPipe: Capacity {{cap}}. Click a port (or the ground, which places a support) to start and click again to finish. If you finish on the ground, drawing continues from there. Up to 56 m per segment.
side.createRoute: Create a route from this station
side.selectionHelp: <kbd>R</kbd> rotate · <kbd>Del</kbd> delete · <kbd>Ctrl+X</kbd> move · <kbd>Ctrl+C</kbd>/<kbd>Ctrl+V</kbd> copy · right-click: options
side.wholePlanSummary: {{structures}} buildings · {{segments}} segments. Drag over the plan to select an area and see its materials.
side.controlsView: Wheel: zoom · Middle button or <kbd>Space</kbd>+drag: pan · <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd>/<kbd>Y</kbd>: undo/redo · <kbd>Shift</kbd>+click: add to selection · right-click: options
side.controlsBuild: Foundations: drag to fill an area · click the loose end of a belt or pipe: keep drawing it
side.drawingHelpHyper: Click a hypertube entrance, junction or floor hole (or the ground, which places a support) to start and click again to finish. If you finish on the ground, drawing continues from there. Up to 100 m per segment; it costs its materials for every meter.

machine.overclock: Overclock: needs {{n}} power shard(s). Use it only if there is no alternative.
machine.somersloopsHelp: Produces +{{pct}} % from the same inputs; power usage is multiplied by {{mult}}.
machine.outputSlack: What is connected downstream does not consume everything it produces.
machine.inputShort: Not enough material arrives to run at 100 %.
machine.underclockHint: Lowering the clock to {{pct}} runs it with no waste.

calc.title: Production calculator
calc.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to make… (e.g. Modular Frame)
calc.onlyUnlocked: Only recipes unlocked in my progress
calc.splitFull: At 100 % plus one with the rest
calc.intro: Search for a product, enter how many you want per minute and I will build the whole chain down to the raw resources.
calc.heading: {{rate}} {{item}} per minute
calc.colImportTitle: Do not make it here: you bring it from elsewhere
calc.byproductsHelp: They must be taken out (stored, used or sent to the AWESOME Sink) or the machine stops.
calc.wireSummary: With connections: {{segments}} segments ({{meters}} m) with mergers, splitters and pipeline junctions in manifolds. The miners and extractors go at the bottom, with the best tier you have unlocked and the exact clock, and the final product exits to the right. Where two lines cross, in the game one goes over the other on a taller pole.
calc.placeHint: It is placed to the right of what you already have, with recipes and clocks set.
calc.minersOre: Miners Mk.1 on a normal node

build.beltShort: {{item}}: {{rate}}/min exceeds the fastest belt available; consider splitting it into two lines.
build.pipeShort: {{item}}: {{rate}}/min exceeds the fastest pipeline available; consider splitting it into two lines.
build.miners: Miners and extractors sized for normal nodes at the exact clock; in the game each goes on its own node: if yours is pure or impure, change the purity on the miner and the app recalculates.
build.byproduct: Byproduct: {{item}} ({{rate}}/min) exits to the right; store it, use it or send it to the AWESOME Sink so the machine does not stop.
build.looseBelt: {{item}}: comes in through a loose pole at the bottom; connect whatever brings it there.
build.loosePipe: {{item}}: comes in through a loose support at the bottom; connect whatever brings it there.
build.skippedFluids: {{n}} fluid output(s) with no port to connect.

progress.title: My progress
progress.filter: Filter the build menu and recipes by what is unlocked
progress.phaseQuestion: Space Elevator phase you are in:
progress.altHelp: Alternate recipes are obtained by analyzing Hard Drives in the M.A.M. Check the ones you have already chosen.

account.publicTitle: Shared: click to make it private
account.privateTitle: Private: click to share it with the community
account.shareHelp: Anyone will be able to view the plan in Community and save a copy. Your later changes will show too. You can make it private again at any time.
account.descriptionPlaceholder: What it makes, how many machines, what needs to be unlocked…
account.profileHelp: This is how other players see you on the plans you share.

auth.keepsDrawing: Whatever you have drawn is saved to your account when you sign in.
